Color
Semantic color tokens for surfaces, text, icons, borders, and status indicators.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

overview        Overview - Colors are semantic: tokens describe purpose, not appearance. Every color adapts
                automatically between light and dark modes via CSS light-dark(). Themes override the resolved values, so
                your code never references raw hex colors.
surface-colors  Color Tokens - Layered surface hierarchy: body -> surface -> card -> popover. Each level sits visually
                above the previous one.
usage           Use color tokens in StyleX - Import the typed color tokens and use them in `stylex.create()`; they
                resolve to the active theme and color mode.
best-practices  Best Practices - Use semantic tokens (--color-text-primary) instead of raw hex values.
